scenes.title: Ring Alarm Pro: Worth Buying?
scenes.body: We just installed a 14-piece kit in Chantilly, VA. Here's our honest take.

scenes.title: The brain of the system
scenes.body: Sensors, keypad and siren all connect to it. Arm and disarm from your phone or the keypad.

scenes.title: eero Wi-Fi 6 router built in
scenes.body: Covers up to 1,500 sq ft and supports 75+ connected devices. Use it as your router or join your network.

scenes.title: Contact sensors on doors & windows
scenes.body: Get an alert the moment a door or window opens.

scenes.title: Motion detectors
scenes.body: Mounted high in a corner to cover the room.

scenes.title: Keypad by the main door
scenes.body: Arm, disarm and set access codes for everyone at home.

scenes.title: 4 · Backup & monitoring
scenes.body: Battery time is in Low Power Mode. Check ring.com for current plans and prices.

scenes.title: 14-piece kit + 2 extra sensors
scenes.body: Our Chantilly install took under 2 hours, tested and explained.

scenes.title: Watch out for
items: Backup internet & monitoring need a plan
Plan where the base station goes

scenes.title: Worth it for whole-home security
scenes.body: especially if you already use Ring or need better Wi-Fi.

scenes.title: Want it installed for you?
scenes.body: Ring Authorized Dealer based in Sterling, VA. We place every sensor and test the system.
